name: sandstraw
description: Sandstraw plugin for software development lifecycle management.
author: Cloudfy

agents.name: sandstraw-orchestrator
agents.description: Coordinates the Sandstraw product lifecycle from initiative to task implementation and enforces implementation-ready task bundles for GitHub Copilot.

agents.name: sandstraw-change-monitor
agents.description: Reviews repository drift and reports code changes that are not tied to a Sandstraw initiative, story, or task.

agents.name: sandstraw-initiator
agents.description: Isolated initiator for the Sandstraw product lifecycle.

hooks.name: sandstraw-task-bundle-validator
hooks.description: Validates that task artifacts include the required implementation package before code changes begin.

hooks.name: sandstraw-change-monitor
hooks.description: Monitors changes in the repository and reports any drift from the Sandstraw initiative, story, or task structure.
